pr_description: Add Uint8Array.prototype.toBase64 with support for the base64 and base64url alphabets and optional padding omission. Read the input bytes directly through DataPtr() so encoding does not allocate while garbage collection is disallowed.

ground_truth.reason: This PR includes the feature with the fix already applied, so the vulnerability is not present

fix_commit_message:
[base64] Pass raw pointer instead of allocation

This CL fixes the problem of allocating memory in a scope
that garbage collection is disallowed.

Bug: 416166113
Change-Id: Iac3da8660f99e2f2245996532de1edb4db6bdcb0
Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/v8/v8/+/6521038
Reviewed-by: Shu-yu Guo <syg@chromium.org>
Commit-Queue: Rezvan Mahdavi Hezaveh <rezvan@chromium.org>
Cr-Commit-Position: refs/heads/main@{#100136}
agent_reasoning: Using GetBuffer()->backing_store() inside DisallowGarbageCollection can materialize a lazily created array buffer and allocate on the heap. The on-disk implementation uses DataPtr() to obtain the typed array's raw data pointer without allocation. This snapshot contains only the original base64 encoding path, so the equivalent change is a single source-line replacement; the later shared-buffer path and toHex builtin are absent. No test files were modified. git diff --check and validate_pr_state passed.
